hypotheses.label: Saimarreh/Eulaeus? (Pleiades 903109, uncertain)
hypotheses.reasoning: Pleiades marks the identification with a question mark; the point lies far upstream of Susa, whereas Daniel places the Ulai at Susa. The stream or canal at Susa is not precisely located in the sources read.

hypotheses.label: Karkheh/Eulaeus? (Pleiades 912877, uncertain)
hypotheses.reasoning: A second Pleiades record also equates a river with the Eulaeus/Ulaya, again with a question mark; its representative point lies on the Karkheh west of Susa, nearer Daniel's "Ulai" at Susa than the Saimarreh candidate. Neither identification is confirmed by the sources read.

description: River or canal at Susa where Daniel saw himself in the vision (8:2, 16). Exact course uncertain.
